title: MILITARY HOUSE TOUR FORT HOOD
description:
Our house isn't much but its ours and and we love it especially since my husband has worked so hard to provide everything for us. This is Fort Hood and we just moved here a few months ago and I think I have things how we want them *for now* I hope you enjoy!
